import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
for rid,n in [(6,3.2),(7,-1.2)]:
 r=open_run(f'data/{rid}'); ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
 B=r.col('magnet_field'); I=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain; R=r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain/I
 ix=np.argsort(B); B,I,R=B[ix],I[ix],R[ix]
 print('RUN',rid,'R',R.min(),R.max(),'I nA',I.min()*1e9,I.max()*1e9,'elapsed min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60)
 for k in ['T_sample','k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr']: print(k,np.min(r.col(k)),np.max(r.col(k)))
 on=sdh_onset(R,B,r_full_scale=5000); print(on.summary())
 fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,8)); ax[0,0].plot(B,R); ax[0,0].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Raw Rxx (ohm)',title=f'Run {rid}, n={n}, D=0; positive B only')
 ax[0,1].plot(B,I*1e9); ax[0,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Drain current (nA)')
 for cutoff in [on.onset_b,1.0,1.5,2.0]:
  for deg in [3,5]:
   f,sp=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(cutoff,10),bg_degree=deg,nfft=4096,log=False)
   p,_=find_peaks(sp[0]); p=sorted([j for j in p if 3<f[j]<60],key=lambda j:sp[0,j],reverse=True)[:6]
   print('FFT',cutoff,deg,[(round(f[j],2),round(sp[0,j],4)) for j in p])
   ax[1,0].plot(f,sp[0]/max(sp[0]),label=f'{cutoff:.2f}-10T deg{deg}')
 ax[1,0].set(xlim=(0,60),xlabel='F (T)',ylabel='Normalized FFT'); ax[1,0].legend(fontsize=7)
 ax[1,1].plot(B,R-np.polyval(np.polyfit(B,R,5),B)); ax[1,1].set(xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='R minus degree-5 background (ohm)')
 fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f'hera_scratch/spot_{rid}.png',dpi=120)
 plt.close(fig)

cat > hera_scratch/ana_spots.md <<'EOF'
## Runs 6–7 — raw SdH checks and fan-design limits

Run 6: electron n=+3.2 ×10¹² cm⁻²; run 7: hole n=−1.2 ×10¹² cm⁻², both D≈0 using run-5 calibration, B₁−B₂ / sr1. These are positive-field traces; no even-in-B symmetrization is available. Current-normalized raw Rxx is plotted first. Both runs completed; drain current stayed 9.81–9.94 nA, |gate current| <0.22 nA, and sample T=1.165–1.292 K. Neither voltage trace approached the 5 kΩ acquisition full scale. Negative Rxx excursions are retained, not log-transformed or clipped.

Electron candidates near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3, and 29.4 T form a near harmonic comb; their identities cannot be inferred from amplitudes or a ratio-only harmonic rejection. F_L=33.09 T has the geometry scale uncertainty. The full-record onset helper is censored at 0.30 T, and the 0.05 T sampling below 1 T cannot support its fast-tone claims. Restricting the background fit to B≤4 T gives 1.03–1.38 T onset across polynomial degree 2–5: a real analysis fork, not an established low-field cutoff. Hole onset is 0.714 T for degrees 2–5, but its low-density ABAB branches approach one another; the current forward model (density input in m⁻²) gives 5.86/6.54 T at −1.2, rather than the inherited proposal's approximate 5.3/7.1 T. Their 0.68 T separation cannot be resolved at this onset even at 10 T (2δF=1.54 T).

**Verdict: B₁−B₂ remains uninformative for stacking at this step.** Oscillations justify pursuing the fan; neither spot yet warrants an ABAB/ABCA/ABCB assignment. Run-5's second CNP ridge remains a spatial-density confound. A fan must preserve these forks, compare the full peak set and one global scale against ABAB/ABCA and adjacent-N models, and test harmonics through density dependence. The electron onset needs a properly sampled low-field check before committing a long FFT fan, per `landau-fan` cost-floor check and `sdh-spot-check` Verify.
EOF

## HERA — resolve the electron onset before sizing the Landau fan

`sdh-spot-check` Verify and `landau-fan` step 1 require a measured, adequately sampled onset; run 6 gives censored / background-dependent answers (ana cells 14–15). Repeat n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 using the same rounded run-5 calibration as run 6, with uniform 1/B sampling from 0.20 to 4.0 T, 635 points (Δ1/B=0.00749 T⁻¹, Nyquist 66.7 T). This captures the ≈29.4 T tone and its observed ≈58.6 T harmonic, extends below the prior 0.30 T analysis edge, and directly tests grid-dependent aliases. Frequencies above 66.7 T are outside this check's claim; run 6 only tracks those at B>4.8 T, which is excluded. Hole run 7 has a robust onset but its predicted ABAB pair is unresolved even at 10 T, so the electron side remains the useful design route.

Keep τ=0.3 s / 24 dB and the driver's 3 s settle (10τ), drive 1 V / 100 MΩ =10 nA, Si=0, heaters off. Set sr1 to 10 µV (1 kΩ nominal full scale), >8× the measured electron resistance below 4 T; sr0 stays 20 mV. SAFETIES cell 18 [10] exactly matches the card; all validators are re-read before moving. Preconditions verify base temperatures, live logs, magnet/output/PS state, wiring and the handoff zero-field state. No gate pacing or limit is changed.

Price: 4 T / 0.137 T/min =29.2 min total field motion from the handoff; run 6's measured non-ramp overhead is 3.08 s/point (120.36 min minus 73 min bare traverse), hence 635 points ≈32.6 min plus gate setup, extra vaporizer read, and margin. Check first 20 points for current, phases, leakage, rails and field tracking, then every 10 min. Abort on |gate current|>1 nA, loss of current, stale/hot thermometry, or rail approach. Interrupt stops the sweep at a safe point; the VTI supply still completes its last issued field target, so actual field must be re-read after any abort. End at 4 T with gates at the spot; the resulting fan will start there or continue outward, avoiding a blind reset.
EOF

print('Expected base 1.0..1.5 K, vaporizer <1.6 K and within 0.6 K, B~0, Si~0; actual', Ts, Tv, B0, Si)
assert 1.0 <= Ts <= 1.5 and 0 < Tv < 1.6 and abs(Ts-Tv)<0.6
assert abs(B0)<0.02 and abs(Si)<0.01
print('Expected heater ranges 0/0, magnet PS/output on:', heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range(), magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
for p, bounds in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),(dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),(magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),(heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:

    print(p.full_name, 'expected',bounds,'actual',actual)
    assert actual==bounds
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
assert k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg and k_si is dc205.smart_voltage
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
print('Expected 1 V/13.777 Hz, tau .3/.3 s, slopes24/24, NPLC1/1:',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr0.time_constant(),sr1.time_constant(),sr0.filter_slope(),sr1.filter_slope(),k_tg.nplci(),k_bg.nplci())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==.3 and sr1.time_constant()==.3 and sr0.filter_slope()==24 and sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.nplci()==1 and k_bg.nplci()==1
assert k_tg.volt.step==.005 and k_bg.volt.step==.005
assert magnet.settle_s>=3 and dc205.ramp_rate==.5 and dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'
assert sr0.sensitivity()==.02
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-.0894,D_offset=-.013)
vt,vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0,**CAL)
k_tg.volt.validate(float(vt)); k_bg.volt.validate(float(vb))
B_vec=1/np.linspace(1/.20,1/4.,635)
assert np.max(np.abs(np.diff(1/B_vec))) < 1/(2*66)
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.validate(float(b))
print('Designed gates and n,D roundtrip:',vt,vb,calc_nD(vt,vb,**CAL))
sr1.sensitivity(10e-6)
mc=dict(meas_config); mc.update({'Si (V)':Si,'sample_temperature:':Ts,'comments':'electron onset repair n=3.2e12 D=0 B=.2->4T uniform 1/B 635 pts; sr1 10uV tau.3 slope24; run6 calibration'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment('onset and grid reproduction: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0; B .20->4.0T 635 uniform-inverse-B points; Vsi=0; sr1 10uV, 10nA; run5 calibration rounded identically to run6')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(vb)); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(vt)); interruptible_sleep(10)
# time, B_set, T_sample, T_vaporizer, Itg, Ibg, sr0X, sr0P, sr1X, sr1P
channels=[T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P]
for p in channels:
    s.fp(p); s.plot(magnet.field,p)
_onset_counter=0
def onset_guard(station,data):
    global _onset_counter
    _onset_counter+=1
    bad=[]
    if not (1.0<=float(data[2])<=1.5 and 0<float(data[3])<1.6): bad.append('temperature')
    if max(abs(float(data[4])),abs(float(data[5])))>1e-9: bad.append('leakage')
    if not 8e-9 < float(data[6])/-1e6 < 12e-9: bad.append('drain current')
    if abs(float(data[8]))>.9*10e-6 or abs(float(data[6]))>.9*.02: bad.append('rail approach')
    if _onset_counter%20==0:
        actual_B=magnet.field()
        print('CHECKPOINT B set/read',data[1],actual_B)
        if abs(actual_B-float(data[1]))>.02: bad.append('field mismatch')

            try: assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
            except Exception as exc: bad.append(str(exc))
    if bad:
        print('STOP:',bad); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
